item.title: Civil Engineer I
item.description:
INTRODUCTION

Crawford, Murphy & Tilly is seeking a Civil Engineer to join our Water Resources group in the St. Louis, MO office. This is not a remote position.

We are a fast-growing firm with 500+ employees across 25 offices in 10 states serving clients through our four primary business groups:

  • Aviation
  • Surface Transportation
  • Water Resources
  • Building & Site Services

CMT provides planning, environmental, design, and construction observation phase services on projects in all four of these groups and more, which range from simple to complex.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Water Resource Civil Engineer, you'll play a key role in working with senior staff to support a wide range of municipal infrastructure projects, working closely with experienced engineers on planning, design, permitting, and construction-phase services.

What you will do:

  • Support water, wastewater, and stormwater municipal infrastructure projects from planning through construction
  • Projects may include water supply and treatment, water distribution mains, water storage, sanitary sewers, water and wastewater pump stations, wastewater treatment, and stormwater systems
  • Work on periodic construction observation in the field
  • Attend team meetings and contribute ideas
  • Develop technical reports and present collaborative ideas
  • Be open to feedback and professional growth
  • Engineering new grads: assist with plan preparation & field visits alongside experienced engineers

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Here is what you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or your technical field is required.
  • Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, ArcGIS
  • Strong technical aptitude and familiarity with Microsoft Office.
  • Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills, with a willingness to learn.
  • Ability to work in the field, as needed, for engineering roles.
  • Possession of a current and valid driver’s license to travel to field sites, as needed, for engineering roles.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Ideally, you will also have:

  • 0-4 years of Civil Engineering or internship experience related to your field.
  • FE certification or the ability to obtain certification
  • Previous internship or co-op experience

BENEFITS

CMT offers a generous benefits program, focused on four pillars: Health & Wellness, Work + Life Balance, Financial Health & Retirement, and Career Development. To learn more about the CMT benefit programs, review the information on our website, Careers - CMT Infrastructure Professionals.

COMPENSATION

The expected compensation range for this position is $70,500 - $76,000 annually. The final agreed-upon compensation is based on numerous factors, including but not limited to individual education, qualifications, prior work experience, and geographic location.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYMENT (EEO) POLICY

Crawford, Murphy & Tilly (CMT) is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing employment opportunities to minorities, females, veterans and disabled individuals, as well as other protected groups.

ACCOMMODATIONS FOR APPLICANTS

Applicants wishing to apply for an open position with CMT who require a reasonable accommodation in order to complete the application process may contact CMT’s Human Resources Department at kallen@cmtengr.com to request assistance. CMT is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

UNSOLICITED APPLICATIONS

CMT does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications. Staffing and recruiting agencies, and individuals being represented by an agency, are not authorized to use this site or to submit applications or resumes, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. CMT is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

item.title: Sr. Civil Engineer
item.description:
INTRODUCTION

Are you a driven and experienced Civil Engineer looking to make a significant impact on water and wastewater treatment projects? Join our dynamic team and take on a rewarding role as our Sr. Civil Engineer, where you'll have the chance to work on a wide range of projects, from designing new treatment facilities to improving existing infrastructure. Take this opportunity to showcase your expertise and contribute to the development of sustainable solutions that ensure clean water for communities. Not only will you have direct impact on the communities we serve but you will mentor the next generation of engineers within our Water Design Center.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams, including civil, process, mechanical, structural, electrical, and I&C engineers, to deliver comprehensive and innovative designs that meet project objectives.
  • Completing civil designs including grading, paving, stormwater and yard piping routing and design for large, complex sites.
  • Manage multiple projects concurrently, ensuring timely delivery, budget adherence, and exceptional quality of work products.
  • Actively mentor and develop junior team members, fostering their growth as design professionals and preparing them for increased responsibilities.
  • Embrace the opportunity for fieldwork and travel to support site assessments and provide construction support as needed.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering from an ABET accredited program
  • 5 or more years of civil site design experience
  • Registered Professional Engineer (PE) strongly preferred
  • Strong communication skills as required to manage project teams and maintain internal client relationships
  • Experience with Autodesk software including AutoCAD and Civil 3D
  • Must have a basic understanding of the multi-disciplined practices (i.e. process, surveying, geotechnical, structural, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation & control) required for the implementation of water/wastewater infrastructure improvements
  • Strong teaching and coaching skills to mentor and communicate with team members of all levels
  • Previous experience as manager in charge of civil or related design, including detailed plans and specifications, for major water and wastewater treatment plant improvements projects
  • Experience with land development in the private sector is preferred

LOCATION

Join our Water Design Center in Fayetteville and be at the forefront of site development design that contributes to clean water and sustainable development. Make a lasting impact as a Sr. Civil Engineer and bring your expertise to the forefront of water and wastewater treatment projects. Apply today and embark on an exciting journey with us!

ABOUT GARVER’S FAYETTEVILLE WATER DESIGN CENTER

The Water Design Center (WDC) is a knowledge-based hub that excels in highly technical, multi-discipline water and wastewater designs. The WDC specializes in large, high-volume, custom treatment plant projects with advanced technologies. Centralizing the location of the WDC means communication, coordination, and participation with team members is constant. This integral working relationship benefits the client through project delivery schedule and design quality, as well as opportunity for team collaboration and professional growth.

GROW WITH US

Garver offers its employees programs such as company-paid professional memberships, company support for industry licenses and continuing education opportunities that foster a progressive atmosphere. Garver provides the tools, resources, and environment to develop leaders, stimulate ideas, and accomplish projects. By offering highly competitive salary packages, attractive benefits, and a comprehensive wellness program; Garver walks the talk when it comes to work-life balance.

Founded in 1919, Garver is an employee-owned engineering, planning, and environmental services firm focused on aviation, transportation, buildings, federal, water and wastewater services; surveying; advisory services; and construction engineering and inspection. In the top 100 of Engineering News-Record’s Top 500 Design Firms list, with more than 1,400 employees, Garver provides an exceptional level of client service that reflects our people-first culture, which has achieved Zweig Group Best Firm to Work For Legacy Status. Learn how Garver invests in people and places they call home at GarverUSA.com.

Garver is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Our employment practices are based upon an individual's capabilities and qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

item.title: Site Civil Engineer
item.description:
Description

Waggoner Engineering, Inc. is seeking a Site Civil Engineer to join our team in our Birmingham, AL or Huntsville, AL office. This role supports our continued growth and offers the opportunity to work on (or support) meaningful projects alongside a collaborative, experienced team. You’ll have the chance to build your career while contributing to impactful solutions across the communities we serve.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage civil/site projects from concept through design and delivery
  • Prepare and oversee design for grading, drainage, utilities, and site layout
  • Perform and review engineering calculations, plans, specifications, and reports
  • Serve as engineer of record and ensure strong QA/QC on all deliverables
  • Coordinate with architects, developers, and internal disciplines to support integrated project delivery
  • Manage project scope, schedule, and budget to ensure on-time, on-budget performance
  • Mentor and support the development of junior engineers and designers
  • Participate in client meetings and support proposal development as needed
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related field
  • Active PE license required (or ability to obtain within six months if applicable)
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in civil/site design, land development, or civil infrastructure
  • Strong experience with grading, drainage, and utility design
  • Proficiency in Civil 3D and standard design tools
  • Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders
  • Strong communication and organizational skills

Preferred:

  • Experience working with both private development and public-sector clients
  • Familiarity with local permitting and regulatory processes
  • Experience supporting business development or client relationship management

Why Join Our Team

We know work isn't only about what you do, it's also about who you work for and with! Waggoner Engineering provides a fun, family-friendly, and multicultural work environment that supports a work life balance, including:

  • WEI Incentive Program
  • Healthy Workplace Program
  • Employee Referral Bonus
  • Competitive Health Benefits
  • Career Development and Training
  • Flexible/Hybrid Schedule
  • Community Service Opportunities

Waggoner Engineering, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

About Waggoner

Waggoner is a multidisciplinary infrastructure and advisory firm focused on transforming communities and advancing the systems that support them. Our teams bring together engineering, science, business, environmental expertise, digital innovation, program delivery, and strategic insight to solve complex challenges facing communities, industries, and governments.

We believe infrastructure is more than projects - it is the foundation of resilient communities, economic opportunity, and a stronger future. By integrating technical excellence with environmental stewardship, data-driven insights, and collaborative problem solving, Waggoner helps our clients realize what’s possible and delivers solutions that create lasting impact for the people and places we serve.

Our culture is built on integrity, accountability, collaboration, and excellence. We empower talented professionals to lead, innovate, and work across disciplines to deliver meaningful outcomes for our clients and communities.

Our Vision

To be the trusted partner organizations turn to for integrated solutions that strengthen communities, advance infrastructure, and solve complex challenges.

Our Mission

Transforming communities. To improve the quality of life for our clients, communities, and employees by delivering innovative, resilient, and sustainable solutions that make a lasting difference.

Our hiring process

Stage 1: Applied
Stage 2: Initial Screening
Stage 3: 1st Interview
Stage 4: Offer
Stage 5: Hired

item.title: Site Civil Engineer
item.description:
INTRODUCTION

Design Group is seeking a Site Civil Engineer for a full-time, on-site role at our Louisville, KY or Columbus, IN location. The position involves developing civil engineering designs, preparing detailed plans using engineering best practices, and collaborating with project teams on planning and stormwater management. The candidate will contribute to project execution, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards while maintaining the company’s commitment to quality and innovation. Interaction with clients to address project needs and requirements will also be a key part of the role.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Proficiency in Civil Engineering Design and related methodologies
- Experience in Planning and executing engineering projects
- Knowledge of Stormwater Management principles and practices
- EIT certification required. PE certification is a plus but not required.
- Ideal candidate will have 3 to 5 years of applied experience.
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills
- Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and clients
- Familiarity with industry-standard tools and software
- Previous experience in land development projects is a plus

item.title: Staff Civil Engineer
item.description:
Description

The Burns & McDonnell transportation team is growing in Chicago! Looking for a highly motivated and skilled Staff Civil Engineer to join our group. This position will work closely with our roadway engineering team to provide support across a wide variety of infrastructure projects including varying size projects for DOTs, counties, tollway, Design-Build, and other civil support.

Burns & McDonnell is a 100% employee-owned company, where you are not only provided an ownership stake, but you get to contribute to the direct success of the company, our clients, and our team. The employee ownership culture runs strong and provides endless opportunity for entrepreneurial thoughts and for career growth.

As a Staff Civil Engineer, you will have the opportunity to engage in meaningful and unique ways at Burns & McDonnell, including:

  • Opportunity to experience project management and technical engineering: Assist with project management tasks and leading technical engineering designs to get exposure to the different areas of a project and helping to determine strengths and develop skillsets.
  • Opportunity to innovate: Use AI, emerging technologies, and creative problem-solving techniques to develop solutions that improve engineering workflows and project outcomes.
  • Direct exposure to clients and stakeholders: Participate in discussions with project teams, stakeholders, and clients to help deliver safe, efficient, and technically sound engineering solutions.
  • A voice in the process: Contribute fresh ideas, ask questions, and provide new perspectives that are actively considered in technical discussions and project decisions.

This exciting position involves contributing to a collaborative work environment, working alongside some of the top industry leading experts, and ample potential to grow your career and knowledge base. This position works closely with everyone within the team from entry level staff up through senior leadership on technical design of transportation projects such as route planning studies, feasibility studies, roadway PS&E and schematic designs, and progressive design build projects. You will have exposure to a variety of clients, tasks, and projects from within the Chicago office and across the company. The ideal candidate brings their strong engineering foundation from the transportation highway industry to the table while having the motivation to further drive their technical skill set, engineering abilities and communication skills.

This Staff Civil Engineer position offers incredible career advancement potential for motivated individuals seeking to advance their career with a company that invests in you. As a Staff Civil Engineer, you will work in a multidisciplinary integrated design team to perform the following duties:

  • Work with a team of designers and engineers in the preparation of design details, plans, and drawings to meet project deadlines.
  • Perform technical roadway design such as preparing horizontal alignments, profiles, intersections, and interchange layouts.
  • Support engineering staff with related design experience in drainage, signing and marking, traffic control and construction sequencing, and illumination.
  • Develop design criteria, design calculations, construction details, quantities, and cost estimates in accordance with the latest industry standards.
  • Participate in Transportation QA/QC processes for project deliverables and submittals.
  • Provide internal and external clients with professional and responsive service.
  • Support the Design Department in achieving the Vision & Values of the Transportation Global Practice.
  • Assist with other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering or related degree from an ABET accredited program and 3 years of civil engineering experience, consulting preferred. Required or
  • Bachelor Degree in Civil or related Engineering Technology from an ABET accredited program and successful completion of Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam and 3 years of civil engineering experience, consulting preferred. Required or
  • Master Degree in Civil Engineering and 2 years of civil engineering experience, consulting preferred. Required
  • Strong knowledge in standard civil engineering techniques, principles and procedures.
  • Strong knowledge of transportation design standards including AASHTO design guidelines preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of transportation engineering software including Bentley MicroStation, InRoads and/or Geopak and OpenRoads preferred.
  • Has the ability to balance multiple projects and deadlines in an organized fashion strongly preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to adapt plans according to budget constraints, design factors or client needs is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work methodically and analytically in a quantitative problem-solving environment and demonstrated critical thinking skills.
  • Proficient computer skills (e.g. Microsoft Office Suite).
  • Basic computer skills and civil analysis programs.
  • Strong attention to detail, facilitation, team building, collaboration, organization and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills.
  • Embraces ownership of daily tasks and responsibilities.
  • Exhibits the ability to meet deadlines and budget strongly preferred.
  • Prioritizes client success.
  • Previous experience with local clients including Illinois Department of Transportation, Illinois Tollway and municipalities projects strongly preferred.

Compensation

  • Salary: $105,000.00-155,000.00 Yearly

The expected compensation range for this position is displayed in compliance with all local/state regulations. The expected compensation range for this position is based on a number of factors, including but not limited to: individual education, qualifications, prior work experience and work location. The total annual compensation package will consist of a base salary and eligibility to participate in our discretionary year-end incentive bonus program.

Benefits

Our extensive benefits package takes care of you so that you can focus on doing great work. From insurance and disability to time off and wellness programs, we provide the tools to meet your needs. As part of being 100% employee-owned, eligible employees participate in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) in addition to our 401(k) retirement program. For more information, please visit the Benefits & Wellness page.

This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.
